messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — rolling out service-x v4.3.1 to prod in ~15m. Change window 02:00-03:00 PST. Canary -> 5%, then 30%. changelist #4321.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout queued by @Jordan. Canary start in 10m. /deploy service-x:v4.3.1 -> canary(5%)

Mira: Quick question — what's the backout plan/runbook for this? any special steps for priority queues?

Jordan: Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood.com/runbooks/service-x/priority-evac.md 
Key points pasted: 
- STOP router traffic to canary nodes
- PIN clients to stable fallback via routing policy
- Roll image back to v4.2.9 on all canary pods
- Flush local caches and restart workers (kvcache flush)
- Notify downstream teams + incident channel

Mira: ty. any commands I should have ready?

Jordan: Keep these handy: 
```
# roll back deployment image
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/service-x service-x=redwood/service-x:v4.2.9 --record
# helm rollback (if needed)
helm -n prod rollback svc-x-prod 2
# pin routing to stable
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/pin -d '{"service":"service-x","version":"v4.2.9"}'
```

Paul: Also add a health-gate: abort if p50 latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive 1m bins OR error rate >1% for 2m. Mira and SRE, confirm thresholds?

sre-oncall: Confirmed thresholds. Also ensure priority queues are drained before killing canary pods. Run: `python tools/drain_queues.py --svc service-x --timeout 120`

Carla: DB migration question — are there any migrations in this release?

Jordan: No schema changes. This is config + runtime improvements. Feature flags toggled on rollout.

Mira: Good. I'll be ready to execute rollback steps if the gate trips. Who does the actual pinning?

Jordan: I will, unless oncall requests takeover. Plan: canary at 5% -> monitor 10m -> escalate to 30% if healthy. If gate fails at any point, immediate rollback and pin to v4.2.9, then postmortem link.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started (5%): service-x@v4.3.1 -> canary-group-a. Link: https://deploys.redwood.com/1854326789

sre-oncall: I'm watching dashboards; will call if latency or error spikes.

10m later — deploy-bot: Canary health OK (error_rate 0.12%, p50 85ms).

Jordan: proceeding to 30% now. Tagging @Mira @sre-oncall for verification.

Mira: watching logs — no queue pressure. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 30%. Progress monitor: https://observability.redwood.com/dashboards/service-x

Paul: Reminder — if we end up rolling back, capture the deploy-bot logs and export `kubectl describe` for all canary pods, plus router pin audit. Those go into the incident ticket.

Jordan: noted. If I hit the abort gate I will post the runbook step number and the commands I ran.

Carla: Thanks — standing by for post-rollout notes.

sre-oncall: All good from my side so far.

Jordan: Thanks team. Will report final status once 30% is stable for 15m.
